Design authority: docs/delivery/workspace-design.md, sections 5.1-5.3, 7.3; courts B/C. Visual references: mockups/workspace-vision-2026-09-22/README.md.
Repository owner: storyatlas4s. Delivery boundary: M1 implementation.
Integration parent: bd-01M16KDH0TM7DF2BC0K08TH0TT; parent relationship does not itself block execution.
Entry dependencies: bd-01M35A7ATR0XECS91Y6F16BY53.

REUSE, SCOPE AND PRESERVATION
Own new pure StoryAtlas matrix lowering plus transcript/header layout. Consume provider-declared fixed cut/order, sparse-cell meaning, measure/outcome/decision packet. Reuse Intaglio and navigation indexes; one device column transform drives header, cells and hit testing. Existing discourse Atlas keeps its own coordinates.

ACCEPTANCE AND FAILURE WITNESSES
1. Every inventory row appears including untimed, failed/unresolved and all-external units; independent expected cells, values, labels and count match the packet.
2. Distinguish absent/unknown from known zero, numeric external quantity from processing failure, coarse support from child localization, and raw alternatives from moved/zero-mass fill decisions.
3. Fixed declared measure scale and supplied accounting survive hidden columns; no row normalization, UI aggregation, inferred remainder or invented child mass.

EVIDENCE
Record exact producer/consumer/dependency revisions, fixture digests, actual commands/results and warnings/skips. Apply design section 11.5 and AGENTS.md to the changed runtime boundary, including compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS and relevant existing/new browser courts for shell changes; use isolated siblings and session-owned project browsers. Documentation-only or human-study evidence is scoped as such. New test names are specifications until implemented and run. No inference, calibration, hosted CI, publication or release is certified by ticket creation.

FALLBACK
Disable only matrix projection; retain source/Voyage routes and complete data/table inspection.

Coordinate one implementation writer and one heavy build at a time. Reserve exact paths when taking the ticket; do not claim other writers' scopes. Keep scientific operations in StoryModel, reuse this application and preserve unrelated edits.
set.title: [M1] Render the exact fixed-cut matrix and aligned recall inventory
